request.style: English, female soprano solo with choir, harp, strings, flute, cello, ethereal and majestic, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The LORD restored his fortunes once again
Gave him twice as much as he had before
His brothers and sisters came to his house
To console and comfort him in his pain

[Verse]
Each gave him a piece of silver and gold
A ring from the hand of one who knew
The LORD blessed the latter part of his life
More than the first he had known

[Chorus]
Keren-happuch is the third of the daughters
Named by the hand of God
No women in the land were as beautiful
As these three in his grace

[Verse]
He had seven sons and three daughters
Born when his joy returned to him
Jemimah first and Keziah second
Then Keren-happuch came after

[Chorus]
Keren-happuch is the third of the daughters
Named by the hand of God
No women in the land were as beautiful
As these three in his grace

[Bridge]
Their father granted them an inheritance
Among their brothers in the land
A justice and generosity seen
In the blessing of his house

[Outro]
Job lived a hundred and forty years
Saw his children to the fourth generation
And so he died old and full of days
In the peace of the Lord
